newsitem.title: USA: US Treasury's 3-, 6-mo bills seen at 4.99/5.03 pct.
newsitem.headline: US Treasury's 3-, 6-mo bills seen at 4.99/5.03 pct.

text.p: The U.S. Treasury's sale of $26.0 billion in three- and six-month bills on Tuesday is expected to produce average rates of 4.99 percent and 5.03 percent, respectively, traders said.
In when-issued trade at around 1225 EST/1725 GMT, three-month bill rates were quoted at 4.985 percent. Six-month bill rates were quoted at 5.03 percent.
The bidding deadline for the auction is 1300 EST/1800 GMT. Results are expected around 1345 EST/1845 GMT.
